after.title: CHOP versus LOPP for naïve canine T-cell lymphoma
after.status: Current — listed on MSU Oncology Clinical Trials
after.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. Initial consultation, routine bloodwork and chemotherapy are owner-paid except the first doxorubicin (CHOP) or lomustine/CCNU (LOPP) dose, its administration and associated bloodwork. Recheck examination fees are covered. Approximately $250 for T-cell diagnosis performed at MSU is credited after study completion or progression; unrelated care remains owner-paid.
after.notes: Randomized CHOP versus LOPP chemotherapy for treatment-naïve peripheral T-cell lymphoma, with genomic analysis. T-zone and cutaneous lymphoma are excluded. No prior chemotherapy or radiation; corticosteroids for up to 10 days may be allowed at the clinician’s discretion. Treatment lasts approximately 4–6 months with visits every 7–14 days, followed by monthly monitoring.

after.title: Neoadjuvant corticosteroid response study for canine mast cell tumors
after.status: Current — listed on MSU Oncology Clinical Trials
after.funding: 🟡 Partially funded. Up to 50% of surgical and histopathology fees are covered; trial-specific prednisone, diphenhydramine and famotidine/omeprazole and calipers are covered after enrollment. Initial consultation and eligibility diagnostics are owner-paid. Additional surgery under the same anesthesia is owner-paid.
after.notes: Pre-surgical corticosteroid treatment for a confirmed cutaneous mast cell tumor on the trunk above the elbow or knee, measuring 2–6 cm in one dimension. Owners measure the tumor daily; MSU visits on days 7 and 14; surgery planned on day 14 ±1, potentially earlier for rapid shrinkage. Excludes metastasis, anticancer treatment including steroids within 7 days, inadequate NSAID washout (<5 days), and systemic conditions interfering with safe steroid use.

before.title: Paccal Vet chemotherapy after splenectomy for canine splenic hemangiosarcoma
before.status: Recruitment completed; positive topline results reported 2026-09-15 — no current enrollment
before.funding: Fully funded: study diagnostics, treatment and examinations are covered.
before.notes: Source conflict retained explicitly: BluePearl's current-studies master and patient listing still display the Paccal Vet pilot, but Bridge Animal Referral Center lists its canine paclitaxel/hemangiosarcoma and feline paclitaxel/tumor cohorts as closed for data review. Vivesto reported canine pilot topline results on September 15, 2026, and feline results on September 17 after recruitment completed July 1. The canine pilot enrolled 26 dogs with stage I or II splenic hemangiosarcoma after splenectomy; four remained in follow-up at analysis. The sponsor describes a possible future pivotal study but no newly enrolling cohort. Older feline owner sign-up and sponsor project pages conflict with completion reports; keep both species out of matching until a new cohort is explicitly confirmed.
